title: OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a joint safety evaluation
summary: OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a first-of-its-kind joint safety evaluation, testing each other’s models for misalignment, instruction following, hallucinations, jailbreaking, and more—highlighting progress, challenges, and the value of cross-lab collaboration.
body: OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a first-of-its-kind joint safety evaluation, testing each other’s models for misalignment, instruction following, hallucinations, jailbreaking, and more—highlighting progress, challenges, and the value of cross-lab collaboration.
summaryZh: OpenAI与Anthropic首次合作开展联合安全评估，互相测试各自模型的对齐状态、指令遵循能力、幻觉现象以及越狱漏洞等。这项跨实验室的联合测评展示了行业在模型安全评测领域的协作进展与面临的挑战。原始信息显示：OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a first-of-its-kind joint safety evaluation, testing each other’s models for misalignment, instruction following, hallucinations, jailbreaking, and more—highlighting progress, challenges, and the value of cross-lab collaboration.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a joint safety evaluation”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI与Anthropic首次公布了联合安全评估的结果，跨实验室测试各自模型的对齐、指令遵循及越狱漏洞。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
